description:
Three months after a devastating nightclub fire, Daniella Hernandez is determined to rebuild Blackgammon Records and protect her family’s legacy. But as she navigates her complicated relationship with Dom Mayfield and the mounting pressures surrounding their music empire, new threats begin to emerge. Meanwhile, Beverly launches an ambitious mayoral campaign, raising the stakes for everyone in her orbit. Pulled between family, romance, power, and loyalty, Daniella soon finds herself caught in a dangerous web of secrets and competing agendas. As tensions rise and alliances shift, she must decide who she can trust while fighting to protect the people and legacy she holds closest.

Sacrifice Season 2 streams exclusively on Paramount+ on September 30.
